Constructor for CATLAS stimulus object

Source: R/stims-constructors.R
catlas_stimulus.Rd

Constructs a validated catlas_stimulus object representing a single composited stimulus: a source image (e.g., a flask or a cartoon of allergic reaction icon) paired with a text label.

Usage

catlas_stimulus(label, image_path, type = c("cue", "outcome"), meta = list())

Arguments

label

character(1). Text label paired with the image.

image_path

character(1). Path to the source image file (PNG, JPEG, or any format supported by magick). The file must exist at construction time.

type

character(1). Stimulus role in the experimental paradigm. One of "cue" or "outcome". Partial matching supported.

meta

list. Optional named list for additional metadata (e.g., trial assignment, counterbalancing codes). Not used by the rendering pipeline.

Value

An object of class "catlas_stimulus" (a named list with fields label, image_path, type, and meta)

Details

catlas_stimulus stores only plain R scalars. No magick objects are embedded, so the rendering backend used by render_stimulus() is fully swappable without modifying the class.

See also

  • render_stimulus() to produce the composited image

  • write_stimulus() to save the result to disk

Other stimuli: print.catlas_stimulus(), render_stimulus(), render_stimulus.catlas_stimulus(), write_stimulus()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# A minimal white PNG to satisfy the file-existence check
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
magick::image_write(magick::image_blank(1L, 1L, "white"), tmp)

stim <- catlas_stimulus(
  label      = "Xyline",
  image_path = tmp,
  type       = "cue"
)
print(stim)
} # }
